title: vo-api: Forward dedupe_key to OrchestratorMsg::StartWorkflow
description: CRITICAL ADR-028/043: Dedupe key extracted and validated but silently dropped in workflow_start handlers. Exactly-once dedup completely non-functional. Fix: Add dedupe_key to OrchestratorMsg::StartWorkflow, implement atomic dedupe check-and-insert in orchestrator, return 409 on duplicate. Files: crates/vo-api/src/handlers/workflow_start.rs:25-37,83-95 and crates/vo-api/src/handlers/workflow.rs:58-70,142-153

title: vo-sdk: Add 4-byte BE length prefix to FD4 writes
description: CRITICAL ADR-012/014: SDK write_success_inner/write_failure_inner write raw JSON to FD4 but engine expects 4-byte big-endian length prefix first. NO SDK task can communicate results back to engine. Engine misinterprets first 4 JSON bytes as length causing Fd4ReadFailed or OOM. Fix: Prepend (bytes.len() as u32).to_be_bytes() before payload. Files: crates/vo-sdk/src/io.rs:59-69,113-130

title: vo-storage: Fix lease acquire TOCTOU race and persist lease
description: CRITICAL ADR-029/043: acquire() has three non-atomic storage ops, NEVER inserts lease into storage. Two concurrent acquire calls can both return LeaseRecord creating split-brain. Fix: Atomic check-fence-allocate-insert, persist via insert_lease(), add concurrent acquire integration test. Files: crates/vo-storage/src/lease_partition/fjall_lease_store.rs:140-178

title: hardline: Replace assert!/expect! with Result in production panic paths
description: P0: Multiple production crash vectors. ReservedPermitBudget::new() assert! on invalid input (budget.rs:39, actor/budget.rs:39). SystemTime::now().duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap() in events.rs:187. LazyLock+expect() in task_store.rs:121 crashes on corrupt file. ConfigManager::new().expect() in config_core.rs:554,561. 9 RwLock expect('lock poisoned') in agent_registry. Fix: Return Result, propagate errors properly.

title: vo-ipc: Add PR_SET_PDEATHSIG to MessageBus spawn
description: HIGH ADR-012: MessageBus::spawn sets setpgid and FD_CLOEXEC but NOT prctl(PR_SET_PDEATHSIG, SIGTERM). Child processes survive as orphans if engine crashes. Fix: Add prctl call to pre_exec in bus.rs matching run.rs:39 pattern. Files: crates/vo-ipc/src/bus.rs:81-100

title: vo-actor: Validate ExecProbe command path against allowlist
description: HIGH ADR-012: ExecProbe accepts arbitrary command: String and args: Vec<String> without validation. Attacker can specify any executable via API/CLI config. Fix: Validate command exists within engine known binary directory, reject paths outside allowed prefix. Files: crates/vo-actor/src/probe.rs:468-512

title: vo-ipc: Separate argv from fd3_payload in SubprocessConfig
description: HIGH ADR-014: argv() parses fd3_payload as command-line arguments via split_whitespace(). fd3_payload should be exclusively for JSON state per ADR-014. Command-argument injection vector. Fix: argv should be separate explicit field on SubprocessConfig. Files: crates/vo-ipc/src/config.rs:59-62,99-104

title: vo-actor: Change SpawnSupervisor to take (executable, args)
description: HIGH ADR-012: ProcessManager::spawn_process takes raw &str command. Any impl that shells out (sh -c) is vulnerable to injection. Fix: Change to (executable: &Path, args: &[String]), validate path. Files: crates/vo-actor/src/spawn_supervisor.rs:358-359,804-809

title: hardline: Add shell metachar validation to HookRunner
description: HIGH ADR-014/012: HookRunner::run_hook() executes arbitrary commands from Hook.command/Hook.args with no validation. AgentConfig validates but Hook does not. Attacker writing to .scp/hooks/ achieves code execution. Fix: Validate against dangerous chars, check file ownership. Files: crates/core/src/hooks.rs:273-279

title: hardline: Validate branch names against git refname rules
description: HIGH ADR-014/012: Branch names passed directly to git checkout/rebase without validation. Git argument injection via crafted branch names. Fix: Validate against git refname rules, use gix for mutations. Files: crates/vcs/src/vcs/git/sync.rs:62-109

title: veloxide: Extract generic data structures from vo-types/vo-core into vo-ds
description: P1: vo-types has ~6500 lines of generic DS implementations (B-tree, Cartesian tree, Euler tour tree, Link-cut tree, etc.) that dont belong in domain types. vo-core has red-black tree, segment tree, interval tree, KD-tree, quadtree. Fix: Extract to vo-ds crate. Files: vo-types/src/{btree,cartesian_tree,euler_tour_tree,link_cut_tree,binomial_heap,skew_heap,pairing_heap}.rs, vo-core/src/{red_black_tree,segment_tree,interval_tree,kdtree,quadtree}.rs

title: hardline: Create tokio runtime once in GitHubClientImpl
description: P1 ADR-011: block_on() creates new tokio runtime on every GitHub API call. ~200ms cold start per call, nested runtime panic risk. Fix: Use LazyLock or pass handle, use current-thread runtime. Files: crates/stack/src/infrastructure/github.rs:33-36

title: veloxide: Eliminate WriteBudget and ReservedPermitBudget duplication
description: P1: WriteBudget defined twice (vo-core/src/write_class.rs and vo-storage/src/append.rs) with identical RefCell+Clone anti-pattern. ReservedPermitBudget defined twice (vo-core and vo-actor) with different APIs. RefCell is not Sync, unsafe for actor state. Fix: Move to vo-common, replace RefCell with Cell or AtomicU32.

title: veloxide: Bulk-delete 170+ stale local git branches
description: P1: 201 local branches, ~170 cleanup-eligible. Categories: final-* (8), merge-* (35), temp-* (17), test-* (7), pr* (20+), origin/* stale tracking. Fix: git fetch --prune, bulk delete final-*/merge-*/temp-*/stale-origin branches.

title: veloxide: Decompose 10 worst file-size violators
description: P1: 363 files over 300 lines, 95 production files. Top 10: probe.rs (2032), vo-actor/lib.rs (1914), append.rs (1628), connection_pool/mod.rs (1419), cartesian_tree.rs (1302), message_router.rs (1202), spawn_supervisor.rs (1175), btree.rs (1143), doctor_checks.rs (1075), compensation_saga.rs (1070). Fix: Split each into focused modules per Scott Wlaschin DDD rule.

title: hardline: Consolidate duplicate type definitions across crates
description: P1: VcsStatus in 2 places, QueueStatus in 3 places, AgentStatus in 3 places, SessionStatus in 2 places, OpStatus in 2 places. Fix: Single source of truth in domain layer, other crates import. Replace String with typed enums in CLI contracts.

title: vo-executor: Kill process group not just child on timeout
description: MEDIUM ADR-012: child.kill() sends SIGKILL to child only, not process group. Grandchildren escape. Fix: Use libc::kill(-pgid, SIGKILL). Files: crates/vo-executor/src/subprocess.rs:193

title: vo-executor: Pipe stderr instead of discarding
description: MEDIUM ADR-012: stderr set to Stdio::null(), losing all diagnostic data. Fix: Pipe stderr with bounded capture. Files: crates/vo-executor/src/subprocess.rs:123

title: vo-core: Make DedupeToken::new reject empty strings
description: MEDIUM ADR-028: DedupeToken::new accepts empty strings creating false dedup collisions. Fix: Make new fallible. Files: crates/vo-core/src/admission/control.rs:43-45

title: vo-api: Implement ingress admission handler (currently stub)
description: MEDIUM ADR-028: ingress handler is placeholder test only. No atomic admission logic. Fix: Implement per ADR-028 Section 3. Files: crates/vo-api/src/handlers/ingress.rs:1-12

title: vo-core: Require elevated privileges for circuit breaker force flag
description: MEDIUM ADR-026: force=true bypasses quarantine entirely. Fix: Require operator token. Audit quarantine bypass. Files: crates/vo-core/src/circuit_breaker/mod.rs:55-59

title: hardline: Add O_CLOEXEC to all spawned subprocess FDs
description: MEDIUM ADR-014: No O_CLOEXEC on spawned processes. Child inherits parent FDs. Fix: Add pre_exec to close FDs >= 3. Files: crates/core/src/hooks.rs, crates/vcs/src/vcs/git/sync.rs, crates/vcs/src/infrastructure/git_cli/core.rs

title: hardline: Fix TOCTOU race in MemLockManager acquire
description: MEDIUM ADR-029: Read lock check then write lock insert without re-checking. Double-acquire violates mutual exclusion. Fix: Hold single write lock. Files: crates/core/src/lock.rs:121-167

title: hardline: Implement two-phase SIGTERM then SIGKILL shutdown
description: MEDIUM ADR-019: process.kill() sends SIGKILL immediately, no graceful path. Data corruption risk. Fix: SIGTERM first, wait 2-5 seconds, then SIGKILL. Files: crates/core/src/shutdown.rs:109

title: hardline: Enforce timeout_ms in HookRunner
description: MEDIUM ADR-018: .output() is blocking with no timeout. Hung hook blocks thread forever. Fix: Use tokio::time::timeout around wait. Close stdin. Files: crates/core/src/hooks.rs:273-279

title: veloxide: Complete LifecycleState to match ADR-039
description: P2: LifecycleState missing 6+ required substates: Active::PreparingEffect, Active::CommittingEffect, Suspended::WaitingForSignal, Compensating::Planning, Compensating::Executing, Terminal::Compensated. Current has 9 variants, ADR-039 requires 15+. Fix: Add hierarchical substates.

title: veloxide: Replace serde_json::Value with typed structs in event payloads
description: P2: StepCompleted.routing_projection, StepCompleted.output, EffectCommitted.external_receipt are untyped serde_json::Value. No compile-time field guarantees. Fix: Define RoutingProjection, ExternalReceipt structs. Files: crates/vo-types/src/events/payload.rs:48,72

title: veloxide: Commit untracked source files and tests to main
description: P2: 37 untracked files. New source: admission/budget.rs, budget_ops.rs, circuit_breaker_tests.rs, replay/position_tests.rs, validation/workflow_tests.rs, vo-frontend/tests/serde_round_trip_tests.rs, vo-scheduler/tests/proptest_scheduler.rs, vo-storage/src/receipts/tests.rs, vo-types/src/task_io.rs, vo-core/moon.yml. Fix: Commit new source, add report artifacts to .gitignore.

title: hardline: Twins HTTP proxy unbounded body storage
description: LOW: InMemoryTwinState stores full request body in memory with no limit on total records. Sustained flood of 1MB requests will exhaust memory. Fix: Add max_records limit or eviction policy. Files: crates/twins/src/server.rs:207

title: hardline: Add deduplication to JobProcessor
description: LOW ADR-028: JobProcessor has no deduplication mechanism. Same job may execute multiple times under crash recovery violating exactly-once semantics. Fix: Add command_id/dedupe_key to Job and check DbWriterActor before committing results. Files: crates/orchestrator/src/queue/processor.rs

title: hardline: Delegate AgentId::new to new_checked
description: LOW: AgentId::new(id) accepts any string including empty. Only new_checked() validates. Empty-string agents can be registered bypassing validation. Fix: Make AgentId::new delegate to new_checked or use newtype with validation-only constructor. Files: crates/core/src/agent.rs:23-24
